answer.says: Ramesh, the food is sufficient. I will eat, and then we shall settle the matter of the dhobi before I depart.
answer.thought: The body demands its due, and I shall not argue with it. Kadhi and rice are simple, but they will restore the energy needed for the journey to the Directorate. I must remember to settle the dhobi's bill of three hundred rupees before I leave, as it is due on Saturday and I am already short on vouchers.
